narrative: LCR is 228% and NSFR 141%, with £1.18Bn of HQLA against £518M of stressed outflows. The buffer costs about £7.1M a year in negative carry (HQLA yield 3.45% vs 4.05% cost of funds). The bond maturity wave will pull the LCR to about 195% in January at 78% retention — still far above 100%, but below the 200% internal trigger.
